name: self-compact
description: Lets Claude compact its own context (a real /compact: the chat history stays visible), carry text verbatim across it and resume itself

alwaysInstructions.title: Always keep (summary instructions)
alwaysInstructions.description: Added to the summarizer's instructions on every self-compaction, and on a typed /compact or an auto-compaction of the main conversation where this plugin's compaction hook runs (see the README).

alwaysCarry.title: Always carry (verbatim after the summary)
alwaysCarry.description: Placed verbatim after the summary on every self-compaction (and on other compactions where this plugin's compaction hook runs), e.g. 'Re-read docs/HANDOFF.md before continuing.'

instructionsFile.title: Instructions file (summary instructions)
instructionsFile.description: A file whose text is added to the summary instructions of every compaction this plugin starts or sees, after 'Always keep'. Absolute, under ~/, or relative to the project folder; read fresh at each compaction, first 8,000 characters. With it set, Claude can leave 'instructions' out of its requests.

blockToolsAfterRequest.title: Refuse other tool calls after a request
blockToolsAfterRequest.description: While a requested compaction waits for the turn to end, refuse the main agent's other tool calls, so that the turn ends and the compaction runs before the context fills up. Off: the agent only gets a reminder beside each tool result.

allowAfterRequest.title: Tools still allowed after a request
allowAfterRequest.description: Tool names, separated by commas, that the main agent may still call while a compaction waits (a trailing * matches a prefix), e.g. 'SendMessage, mcp__notes__*'.

burstLimit.title: Most self-compactions per window
burstLimit.description: The request_compaction tool refuses a new request once this many self-compactions ran in the window below, in the same session. 0 = no limit (the default).

burstWindowMinutes.title: Window for the limit above, in minutes
burstWindowMinutes.description: The time span the burst limit counts over, when one is set.

minContextTokens.title: Smallest context worth compacting, in tokens
minContextTokens.description: The tool refuses a request while the context holds fewer tokens than this (where the host reports the size). 0 = no check (the default).

minIntervalMinutes.title: Minimum minutes between self-compactions
minIntervalMinutes.description: The tool refuses a new request within this many minutes of the last self-compaction in the same session. 0 = off (the default; it was 10 before 0.4).

remindAtTokens.title: Remind Claude to compact from this context size, in tokens
remindAtTokens.description: From this context size on, a one-line note asks the main agent to finish the step in hand and call request_compaction: once per turn (beside a tool result, or the prompt that starts the turn), and again within a long turn after every 20,000 tokens of growth. Only where the host reports the size. 0 = off (the default).

autoCompactAtTokens.title: Compact by itself from this context size, in tokens
autoCompactAtTokens.description: A safety net: when a turn of the main agent ends normally with no request waiting and the context is at least this size, the plugin compacts by itself (fixed instructions and 'Always carry' only; no next step is carried, no resume). At most once per 10 minutes. Set it below the host's automatic compaction. 0 = off (the default).

resumeSkipAfterToolCalls.title: Drop the resume prompt after this many tool calls
resumeSkipAfterToolCalls.description: When another message starts the turn after a compaction first, the resume prompt is sent when that turn ends, unless the main agent made at least this many tool calls in it (then the next step was done there). Keep it above the calls your orientation after a compaction takes. 0 = always send it at once, as before 0.6.1.
